title: Billing a lot-tracked receipt removes the item from the month-end stock sheet
summary: After a lot-tracked item is received and then billed, the stock sheet of a later month no longer lists it: the bill writes a COST_ASSIGNED ledger row dated the booking day, and the sheet counts it as a movement after the sheet date, so on hand 140 minus 140 gives zero.
steps: Create a LOT / LOTBASED item and receive two lots by PO dated in September (80 and 60).
Open the month-end stock sheet of a month before today.
expected: The sheet lists 140 in two lots.
actual: The item is absent; before the bill the same sheet shows 140.
where: Backend: COST_ASSIGNED ledger row (document_date = booking day) read as a later movement by the stock sheet.
verify: Run YEAR-07-06; the test.fail turns into a pass when fixed.
status_evidence: Found by the e2e business-year suite and the y25 port, 2026-11-14; kept as test.fail() with a BUG comment.

title: Posting cost of goods sold fails with 'data conflict' when the gross margin percentage overflows
summary: Month close cannot post COGS when the margin percentage does not fit its column; the user sees only 409 data conflict.
steps: On the seeded dev data (opening stock 1,800,000, no items behind it) post a month's COGS when the month's sales are a few hundred.
expected: The entry posts, or a readable message explains the limit.
actual: 409 'data conflict'; the database says numeric field overflow, precision 9 scale 4 on period_close_inventory_close (gross margin percentage).
where: Backend: period_close_inventory_close column size and error message.
verify: Post COGS for a month with tiny sales against the seeded stock value.
status_evidence: Found by the e2e business-year suite and the y25 port, 2026-11-14; kept as test.fail() with a BUG comment.

title: A Modern Trade invoice leaves a permanent 0.01 on the receivable (VAT and AIT rounded separately)
summary: The invoice tax 1,691.8825 is posted as VAT 1,606.22 plus AIT 85.67 = 1,691.89, so the receivable debit is 12,400.01 and the full receipt leaves 0.01 forever; the S&R check shows -0.01 (0.12 after a year).
steps: Invoice a Modern Trade line of 12,400.00 with VAT inside the price.
Read the journal and the receivable after a full receipt.
expected: AR debit 12,400.00; nothing left after the receipt.
where: Backend: SalesTax vat and AIT parts rounded separately.
verify: Invoice 12,400.00 and pay it: receivable is 0.00.
status_evidence: Found by the e2e business-year suite and the y25 port, 2026-11-14; kept as test.fail() with a BUG comment.

title: Purchases and payables check shows a 3,000 difference for a bill paid partly by a credit
summary: A bill of 74,000 paid 71,000 plus a 3,000 credit is FULLY_PAID and its ledger payable is 0, but the month-close P&P check shows sub-ledger 3,000, ledger 0, difference 3,000, in this and every later month.
steps: Create a bill 74,000, pay 71,000, apply a 3,000 bill credit.
Read the month's P&P close check.
verify: The check shows difference 0 after the credit.
status_evidence: Found by the e2e business-year suite and the y25 port, 2026-11-14; kept as test.fail() with a BUG comment.

title: A customer return is not credited back to a sales channel balance
summary: After a 2-unit customer return the bins hold the story's 944 but the sales channels add up to 941.
steps: Sell, ship, then return 2 units from a customer.
Compare the bin total and the channel total of the item.
actual: Channels add to 941 against 944 in the bins.
where: Backend: channel allocation on sales return.
verify: Channel total equals bin total after a return.

title: Importing the same bank statement file twice stores lines without a reference twice
summary: The duplicate check uses the reference only, so lines with no reference are imported again.
steps: Import a CSV whose lines have no reference and confirm.
Upload and confirm the same file again.
actual: The lines are stored a second time.
where: Backend: bank statement import duplicate check.
verify: Import the same file twice: the line count does not change.

title: Bank statement import cannot map one signed Amount column

steps: Upload a CSV with columns Date, Description, Amount (signed).
where: Backend: statement import mapping model; the frontend cannot offer it either.
verify: A signed single-column file maps and imports.

title: Two users matching the same statement line at once: both succeed, last write wins
summary: PUT /bank-reconciliation/statement-lines/{id}/match has no lock or version check, so one user's match is silently lost.
steps: Send two match requests for one statement line with different ledger lines at the same time.
expected: One succeeds, the other is refused.
verify: Exactly one of two concurrent matches succeeds.
status_evidence: Found by the e2e business-year suite and the y25 port, 2026-11-14; kept as test.fail() with a BUG comment.

title: A burst of about 20 parallel requests starves the database pool and turns a 403 into a 500
summary: With a pool of 10 connections a burst of parallel writes made a later request wait 30 s and fail with HikariPool 'Connection is not available'; a view-only user's 403 became a 500.
steps: Send about 20 parallel journal drafts or bank requests, then immediately POST /api/accounting/fixed-assets as a view-only user.
actual: 500 HikariPool-1 Connection is not available, request timed out after 30001ms (total=10, active=10, waiting=1).
where: Backend: datasource pool size / request concurrency.
verify: The permission check answers 403 during a burst.
status_evidence: Found by the e2e business-year suite and the y25 port, 2026-11-14; kept as test.fail() with a BUG comment.
